items.example: We got lost in the old town.
items.simple: You don't know where you are, and you can't find the way.

items.example: I think we're lost. Let's ask someone.
items.simple: You are not sure where you are anymore.

items.example: I have terrible jet lag after the flight.
items.exampleTr: Uçuştan sonra berbat bir jet lag yaşıyorum.
items.simple: After a long flight, your body is tired because the time is different.

items.example: I need to book a ticket for Friday.
items.simple: You pay and keep a ticket for yourself before you go.

items.example: We almost missed the flight!
items.simple: You come too late, and the plane has already gone.

items.example: Let's head for the beach.
items.simple: You go in the direction of a place.

items.example: Bye! Have a safe trip!
items.simple: You say this to someone who is going away, so they stay safe.

items.example: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
items.simple: You ask if someone is already sitting there.

items.example: I'll send you our itinerary.
items.simple: A plan that says where you go and when.

items.example: It was a long journey by train.
items.simple: Going from one place to another place, usually far.

items.example: I haven't packed my bags yet.
items.simple: You put your clothes and things in a bag before a trip.

items.example: We're thinking of going to Spain in July.
items.simple: You are not sure yet, but you like the idea.

items.example: We're flying out on Monday morning.
items.simple: You will go away by plane on that day.

items.example: The departure time is nine o'clock.
items.simple: The time when a plane or train goes away.

items.example: Have your boarding pass ready.
items.simple: A paper that lets you get on the plane.

items.example: We went to the station to see him off.
items.exampleTr: Onu yolcu etmek için istasyona gittik.
items.simple: You say goodbye to someone at the place they leave from.

items.example: We need to get away for a weekend.
items.exampleTr: Bir hafta sonu için kaçıp gitmemiz lazım.
items.simple: You leave your home for a rest somewhere else.

items.example: Where are you heading this summer?
items.simple: You ask where someone is going.

items.example: Let's go sightseeing tomorrow.
items.simple: You walk and look at nice places.

items.example: Check the train timetable first.
items.simple: A list that says when buses or trains go.

items.example: We waited an hour at customs.
items.simple: The place at the airport where people check your bags.

items.example: We get back on Sunday night.
items.simple: You return to the place you started from.

items.example: They set out before sunrise.
items.simple: You begin a trip, often a long one.
